name: sportsos
description: SportsOS — AI-powered Sports ERP for IIT (ISM) Dhanbad

scripts.build: npm run build:shared && npm run build -w @sportsos/api && npm run build -w @sportsos/web
scripts.lint: npm run lint -w @sportsos/api && npm run lint -w @sportsos/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:shared && tsc --noEmit -p apps/api/tsconfig.json && npm run typecheck -w @sportsos/web
